## Description
Assume each tile is about 1m x 1m. 150 mm (6 inch) with density of 35 kg/m3. &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;Each board comprises extruded polystyrene (XPS) and expanded polystyrene insulation (EPS) &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;that contain millions of air pockets trapped within the foam. &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;Because the polystyrene itself is also highly resistant to heat, &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;the result is a great thermal insulator which can give excellent R-ratings. &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;XPS is often lined with aluminium foil. &#10;&#9;&#9;
